questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english: Under the Sakura Science Program (Open Application) FY2026 guidelines, which of the following regions or groups of countries is EXCLUDED from eligibility?
questions.explanation_english: According to the FY2026 Application Guidelines (Overview), North America, Europe (excluding Ukraine, Central Asia, and the Caucasus), and Oceania (excluding selected island countries and regions) are not eligible for the program.
questions.explanation_hindi: वित्त वर्ष 2026 के आवेदन दिशानिर्देशों (अवलोकन) के अनुसार, उत्तरी अमेरिका, यूरोप (यूक्रेन, मध्य एशिया और काकेशस को छोड़कर), और ओशिनिया (चयनित द्वीप देशों और क्षेत्रों को छोड़कर) इस कार्यक्रम के लिए पात्र नहीं हैं।
key_facts: For FY2026, North America, Europe (excluding Ukraine, Central Asia, and the Caucasus), and Oceania (excluding selected island countries and regions) are not eligible for the program.

questions.question_hindi:
सकुरा साइंस प्रोग्राम (ओपन एप्लीकेशन) वित्त वर्ष 2026 के आवेदन दिशानिर्देशों के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:

1. सैद्धांतिक रूप से, निजी कंपनियों द्वारा नियोजित व्यक्ति इस कार्यक्रम के लिए पात्र नहीं हैं, जब तक कि वे सार्वजनिक मामलों को बढ़ावा देने के लिए आवश्यक न माने जाएं।
2. जापानी मेजबान संगठन के रूप में कार्य करने वाले निजी उद्यमों के मामले में, JST द्वारा केवल हवाई किराया वहन किया जाएगा।
3. मुख्य आमंत्रितों के लिए ऊपरी आयु सीमा 45 वर्ष है।

उपर्युक्त कथनों में से कौन-सा/से सही है/हैं?
questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding the Sakura Science Program (Open Application) Application Guidelines for FY2026:

1. In principle, individuals employed by private companies are not eligible for this program unless deemed vital for promoting public affairs.
2. In the case of private enterprises acting as Japanese host organizations, only airfare is covered by JST.
3. The upper age limit for main invitees is 45 years old.

Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.explanation_english: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. Statement 3 is incorrect because the age requirement specifies: 'Those who are 40 years old or under.'
questions.explanation_hindi: कथन 1 और 2 सही हैं। कथन 3 गलत है क्योंकि आयु आवश्यकता निर्दिष्ट करती है: 'वे जो 40 वर्ष या उससे कम आयु के हैं।'
key_facts:
In principle, those who are employed by private companies are not eligible for this program. However, those who are in a position deemed vital for promoting public affairs are eligible.

*In the case of private enterprises, only airfare will be covered by JST.

iii. Those who are 40 years old or under.

1. भारत के भीतर स्थानीय व्यय: DST
2. राउंड ट्रिप हवाई किराया और हवाई अड्डा कर: JST

4. जापान में आवास शुल्क और भोजन व्यय: DST
questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english:
With reference to the financial cost-sharing between DST (India) and JST (Japan) for the SAKURA Science High School Program (SSHP) 2026, which of the following pairs is NOT correctly matched?

1. Local expenditure within India: DST
2. Round trip airfare and airport taxes: JST
3. Travel Insurance: JST
4. Accommodation fees and meal expenses in Japan: DST
questions.explanation_english: Pair 4 is incorrectly matched. Programme Implementation Fees including accommodation fees, meal expenses, and travelling costs in Japan are covered by JST, not DST. DST only bears local expenditures within India.
questions.explanation_hindi: युग्म 4 गलत सुमेलित है। जापान में आवास शुल्क, भोजन व्यय और यात्रा व्यय सहित कार्यक्रम कार्यान्वयन शुल्क JST द्वारा वहन किए जाते हैं, न कि DST द्वारा। DST केवल भारत के भीतर स्थानीय खर्च वहन करता है।
key_facts: DST would be bearing the expenditures related to local expenditure within India, etc. for the selected students and designated supervisors for going to Japan, while JST would cover the following costs: Overseas Airfare: round trip airfare, and airport taxes etc. Programme Implementation Fees: - Accommodation fees, meal expenses, travelling costs in Japan (for students and supervisor) - Travel Insurance

questions.question_hindi:
सकुरा साइंस हाई स्कूल प्रोग्राम (SSHP) 2026 के तहत भारत से चयनित हाई स्कूल के छात्रों के लिए पात्रता शर्तों के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:

1. छात्रों को शैक्षणिक वर्ष 2026-27 के दौरान कक्षा X, XI, या XII में अध्ययनरत होना चाहिए।
2. जापान पहुंचने के समय छात्रों की आयु 15 वर्ष या उससे अधिक होनी चाहिए।
3. वे छात्र जो पहले 10 दिनों तक की अल्पकालिक दर्शनीय स्थलों की यात्रा (short-term sightseeing) के लिए जापान में रहे हैं, वे पूरी तरह से अपात्र हैं।
4. उम्मीदवारों का चयन DST द्वारा विभिन्न NLEPC संस्करणों के INSPIRE MANAK विजेताओं में से किया जाता है।

उपर्युक्त कथनों में से कौन-से सही हैं?
questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding the eligibility conditions for high school students selected from India under the SAKURA Science High School Program (SSHP) 2026:

1. The students must be studying in class X, XI, or XII during the academic year 2026-27.
2. The students must be 15 years old or older at the time of arrival in Japan.
3. Students who have previously stayed in Japan for short-term sightseeing up to 10 days are strictly ineligible.
4. Candidates are selected by DST from INSPIRE MANAK winners across NLEPC editions.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explanation_english: Statements 1, 2, and 4 are correct. Statement 3 is incorrect because students who have visited Japan only for short-term sightseeing (within 10 days) or stayed in childhood are explicitly exempt from the disqualification and remain eligible.
questions.explanation_hindi: कथन 1, 2 और 4 सही हैं। कथन 3 गलत है क्योंकि जिन छात्रों ने केवल अल्पकालिक दर्शनीय स्थलों (10 दिनों के भीतर) के लिए जापान का दौरा किया है या बचपन में रुके हैं, वे अपात्रता से छूट प्राप्त हैं और पात्र बने रहते हैं।

questions.question_hindi:
सकुरा साइंस प्रोग्राम (ओपन एप्लीकेशन) वित्तीय वर्ष 2026 (FY2026) के आवेदन दिशानिर्देशों के संदर्भ में, निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:

1. सकुरा साइंस प्रोग्राम की स्थापना मूल रूप से जापान साइंस एंड टेक्नोलॉजी एजेंसी (JST) द्वारा वर्ष 2014 में की गई थी।
2. ओपन एप्लीकेशन प्रोग्राम के तहत, आवेदन सीधे विदेशी भेजने वाले संस्थान (overseas sending institution) द्वारा तैयार और जमा किया जाना चाहिए।

ऊपर दिए गए कथनों में से कौन-सा/से सही है/हैं?
questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english:
With reference to the Sakura Science Program (Open Application) Application Guidelines for FY2026, consider the following statements:

1. The Sakura Science Program was originally established by the Japan Science and Technology Agency (JST) in the year 2014.
2. Under the Open Application Program, the application must be prepared and submitted directly by the overseas sending institution.

Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.explanation_english: Statement 1 is correct: In 2014, the Japan Science and Technology Agency (JST) established the 'Sakura Science Program.' Statement 2 is incorrect: The guidelines explicitly mandate that the 'Application must be prepared and submitted by the Japanese host organization,' not by the overseas sending institution.
questions.explanation_hindi: कथन 1 सही है: वर्ष 2014 में, जापान साइंस एंड टेक्नोलॉजी एजेंसी (JST) ने 'सकुरा साइंस प्रोग्राम' की स्थापना की थी। कथन 2 गलत है: दिशानिर्देशों में स्पष्ट रूप से उल्लेख है कि 'आवेदन जापानी मेजबान संगठन (Japanese host organization) द्वारा तैयार और प्रस्तुत किया जाना चाहिए', न कि विदेशी भेजने वाले संस्थान द्वारा।
key_facts: In 2014, the Japan Science and Technology Agency (JST) established the “Sakura Science Program.” Since then, the program has invited talented young individuals to Japan... Application must be prepared and submitted by the Japanese host organization.

questions.question_hindi:
डीएसटी (भारत) के सहयोग से आयोजित सकुरा साइंस हाई स्कूल प्रोग्राम (SSHP) के पिछले कार्यान्वयन और वर्ष 2026 के बैच के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:

1. विज्ञान एवं प्रौद्योगिकी विभाग (DST) वर्ष 2015 से इस विनिमय कार्यक्रम में भाग ले रहा है।
2. वर्ष 2026 की घोषणा से पहले, कुल 396 छात्रों और 56 पर्यवेक्षकों ने इस कार्यक्रम को सफलतापूर्वक पूरा किया था।
3. 28 जून 2026 से 4 जुलाई 2026 तक आमंत्रित बैच के लिए, 8वीं, 9वीं और 10वीं एनएलईपीसी (NLEPC) के विजेताओं के साथ-साथ 11वीं एनएलईपीसी के स्तर-I मूल्यांकन में अर्हता प्राप्त करने वाले छात्र भी चयन के लिए पात्र हैं।

ऊपर दिए गए कथनों में से कौन-से सही हैं?
questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding the past implementation and the 2026 batch of the SAKURA Science High School Program (SSHP) conducted in collaboration with DST (India):

1. The Department of Science and Technology (DST) has been participating in the exchange program since 2015.
2. Prior to the 2026 announcement, a total of 396 students and 56 supervisors had successfully completed the program.
3. For the batch invited from 28 June 2026 to 4 July 2026, students who qualified Level-I evaluation of the 11th NLEPC are eligible for selection alongside winners of the 8th, 9th, and 10th NLEPC.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explanation_english: All three statements are correct: DST has participated in SSHP since 2015; exactly 396 students and 56 supervisors have completed the exchange; and JST invited 56 students for 28 June 2026 to 4 July 2026 selected from winners of 8th, 9th, 10th NLEPC and qualifiers of Level-I of 11th NLEPC.
questions.explanation_hindi: तीनों कथन सही हैं: DST 2015 से SSHP में भाग ले रहा है; अब तक कुल 396 छात्रों और 56 पर्यवेक्षकों ने विनिमय कार्यक्रम पूरा किया है; और 28 जून 2026 से 4 जुलाई 2026 तक आमंत्रित 56 छात्रों का चयन 8वीं, 9वीं, 10वीं एनएलईपीसी के विजेताओं और 11वीं एनएलईपीसी के स्तर-I मूल्यांकन में अर्हता प्राप्त छात्रों से किया जाएगा।
key_facts: The Department has been successfully participating in the exchange program since 2015. Till now a total of 396 students and 56 supervisors have successfully completed the exchange program. The JST has now invited 56 students in one batch during 28 June 2026- 4 July 2026. Accordingly, DST would be selecting 56 INSPIRE MANAK winners for the SAKURA Science High School Program of Japan. These students would be selected from the winners of 8 th NLEPC/ 9 th NLEPC/10 th NLEPC/ and from students who qualified Level-I evaluation of 11 th NLEPC

questions.question_hindi:
सकुरा साइंस प्रोग्राम (ओपन एप्लीकेशन) FY2026 दिशानिर्देशों के संबंध में निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा युग्म सही सुमेलित नहीं है?

3. नामित पर्यवेक्षकों के लिए अधिमान्य आयु मानदंड: 50 वर्ष या उससे कम
4. स्नातक होने के बाद स्थिति की आवश्यकता: अपात्र, जब तक कि विनिमय संगठन के ग्रेजुएट स्कूल में प्रवेश लेकर नामांकन जारी न रखा जाए
questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english:
Which of the following pairs regarding the Sakura Science Program (Open Application) FY2026 guidelines is NOT correctly matched?

Pair:
1. Permissible previous childhood stay in Japan for high school students: 12 years old and under
2. Eligible fields of exchange: Science and technology (natural sciences, humanities/social sciences)
3. Preferable age criterion for designated supervisors: 50 years old or under
4. Status requirement after graduation: Ineligible unless continuing enrollment by entering graduate school at exchange organization
questions.explanation_english: Pair 3 is NOT correctly matched. The guidelines state: 'It is preferable that the supervisor be 40 years old or under and visiting Japan for the first time through this program', not 50 years old or under. Pairs 1, 2, and 4 are verbatim correct according to section 1 of the guidelines.
questions.explanation_hindi: युग्म 3 सही सुमेलित नहीं है। दिशानिर्देशों में कहा गया है: 'यह बेहतर होगा कि पर्यवेक्षक की आयु 40 वर्ष या उससे कम हो और वह इस कार्यक्रम के माध्यम से पहली बार जापान का दौरा कर रहा हो', न कि 50 वर्ष। युग्म 1, 2 और 4 दिशानिर्देशों के अनुसार बिल्कुल सही हैं।
key_facts: It is preferable that the supervisor be 40 years old or under and visiting Japan for the first time through this program.

questions.question_hindi:
सकुरा साइंस प्रोग्राम के तहत प्रकाशित लोटस (LOTUS) कार्यक्रम और हालिया गतिविधि रिपोर्टों के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:

2. होक्काइडो विश्वविद्यालय में आयोजित FY2026 कोर्स A कार्यक्रम में, प्रतिभागियों को कृषि और स्वास्थ्य विज्ञान में संधारणीय प्रौद्योगिकियों का अध्ययन करने के लिए भारतीय संस्थानों से आमंत्रित किया गया था।
3. कीयो विश्वविद्यालय (Keio University) द्वारा आयोजित FY2026 कोर्स B कार्यक्रम ताइवान के सिंचू शहर में स्थित नेशनल त्सिंग हुआ विश्वविद्यालय के सहयोग से निष्पादित किया गया था।

questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding the LOTUS Programme and recent activity reports published under the Sakura Science Program:

1. The LOTUS Programme specifically comprises two components: “LOTUS-ASPIRE” and “LOTUS Basic”.
2. In the FY2026 Course A program conducted at Hokkaido University, participants were invited from Indian institutions to study sustainable technologies in agriculture and health science.
3. The FY2026 Course B program conducted by Keio University was executed in collaboration with National Tsing Hua University located in Hsinchu City, Taiwan.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explanation_english: All three statements are correct: (1) LOTUS consists of 'LOTUS-ASPIRE' + 'LOTUS Basic'; (2) FY2026 Course A at Hokkaido University was titled 'Experiencing sustainable technologies in agriculture and health science research' involving Indian institutions; (3) FY2026 Course B at Keio University was titled 'Chemical Research for Creating Unexplored Molecules and Developing Global Leaders' conducted with National Tsing Hua University, Hsinchu City, Taiwan.

key_facts: LOTUS Programme Promoting International Talent Circulation by Inviting Graduate Students and Postdoctoral Researchers from India “LOTUS-ASPIRE” + “LOTUS Basic” ... Course A Hokkaido University "Experiencing sustainable technologies in agriculture and health science research" ... participants from three Indian institutions ... Course B Keio University "Chemical Research for Creating Unexplored Molecules and Developing Global Leaders" This program is an initiative conducted between Keio University and National Tsing Hua University, located in Hsinchu City—a key high-tech industry hub in Taiwan.

questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding the delegation of Indian students participating in the Sakura Science Programme 2026 flagged off in May 2026:

1. All participating students from India are beneficiaries of the National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship (NMMS) Scheme.
2. The Indian contingent comprises 56 students (24 boys and 32 girls) selected from government schools across 15 States and Union Territories.
3. The Indian students undertake the visit to Japan alongside participants from Ghana, Nigeria, and South Africa.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explanation_english: According to the official release, all 56 participating students (24 boys and 32 girls) from government schools across 15 States and UTs are beneficiaries of the National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship (NMMS) Scheme. They visited Japan from May 24 to May 30 alongside participants from Ghana, Nigeria, and South Africa.
questions.explanation_hindi: आधिकारिक विज्ञप्ति के अनुसार, 15 राज्यों और केंद्र शासित प्रदेशों के सरकारी स्कूलों के सभी 56 प्रतिभागी छात्र (24 लड़के और 32 लड़कियां) राष्ट्रीय साधन-सह-योग्यता छात्रवृत्ति (NMMS) योजना के लाभार्थी हैं। उन्होंने घाना, नाइजीरिया और दक्षिण अफ्रीका के प्रतिभागियों के साथ 24 मई से 30 मई तक जापान का दौरा किया।
key_facts: A total of 56 students and four supervisors will visit Japan from May 24 to May 30 under the programme, alongside participants from Ghana, Nigeria and South Africa. All participating students are beneficiaries of the National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship (NMMS) Scheme of the Government of India.

1. कोर्स D मुख्य रूप से 40 वर्ष या उससे कम आयु के विज्ञान और प्रौद्योगिकी क्षेत्रों में काम करने वाले छात्रों, शोधकर्ताओं, संकाय सदस्यों या व्यक्तियों के लिए लक्षित है।
2. कोर्स D के तहत भारत के साथ विनिमय में, एक ही विनिमय परियोजना में कई भारतीय संस्थान शामिल हो सकते हैं, लेकिन भारत के बाहर के संस्थान भाग नहीं ले सकते।
3. कोर्स D के तहत अफ्रीकी देशों के साथ विनिमय में, अफ्रीका के बाहर के संस्थान भाग ले सकते हैं बशर्ते वे कम से कम दो अफ्रीकी देशों के साथ साझेदारी करें।

questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding Course D (Annual Mutual Exchange Course) under the Sakura Science Program FY2026 guidelines:

1. Course D is primarily intended for students, researchers, faculty members, or individuals working in science and technology fields who are 40 years of age or younger.
2. In exchanges with India under Course D, multiple Indian institutions can participate in a single exchange project, but institutions outside of India cannot participate.
3. In exchanges with African countries under Course D, institutions from outside Africa may participate provided they partner with at least two African nations.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explanation_english: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. Statement 3 is incorrect because the guidelines explicitly state: 'Exchanges with African countries can include institutions from multiple African countries but cannot include institutions from outside of Africa.'
questions.explanation_hindi: कथन 1 और 2 सही हैं। कथन 3 गलत है क्योंकि दिशानिर्देशों में स्पष्ट रूप से कहा गया है: 'अफ्रीकी देशों के साथ आदान-प्रदान में कई अफ्रीकी देशों के संस्थान शामिल हो सकते हैं, लेकिन अफ्रीका के बाहर के संस्थानों को शामिल नहीं किया जा सकता है।'
key_facts: Annual Mutual Exchange Course (hereafter referred to as the “Course D”), in principle, is intended for students, researchers, faculty members, or individuals working in science and technology-related fields and are 40 years of age or younger. The goal is to strengthen the relations between people and institutions in Japan and India/Africa by fostering exchange activities that are sustainable and promotes international talent circulation... For exchanges with India, multiple Indian institutions can be involved in one exchange, but Institutions from outside of India cannot participate. Exchanges with African countries can include institutions from multiple African countries but cannot include institutions from outside of Africa.

questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding the Sakura Science Indian University Program and the Sakura Science Programme's formal nomenclature:

1. The Sakura Science Programme was formally known as the Japan-Asia Youth Exchange Program in Science.
2. The dedicated Sakura Science Indian University Program was introduced in the financial year 2023.

questions.explanation_english: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. The Sakura Science Programme was formally known as the Japan-Asia Youth Exchange Program in Science, launched in 2014. questions.explanation_hindi: कथन 1 और 2 सही हैं। सकुरा साइंस प्रोग्राम को औपचारिक रूप से 'जापान-एशिया यूथ एक्सचेंज प्रोग्राम इन साइंस' के नाम से जाना जाता था, जिसे 2014 में शुरू किया गया था। भारतीय विश्वविद्यालय कार्यक्रम वित्तीय वर्ष 2023 में शुरू किया गया था। कथन 3 गलत है क्योंकि यह कार्यक्रम विशेष रूप से प्रतिभाशाली भारतीय स्नातक (अंडरग्रेजुएट) छात्रों को शीर्ष स्तर की प्रयोगशालाओं और कॉर्पोरेट अनुसंधान सुविधाओं में आमंत्रित करता है।
key_facts: The Sakura Science Programme, formally known as the Japan-Asia Youth Exchange Program in Science, was launched by the Japan Science and Technology Agency in 2014. ... questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding the eligibility conditions for invitees under the Sakura Science Program FY2026 (Open Application: Courses A, B, and C) guidelines:

1. High school and technical college students who have stayed in Japan only in their childhood (12 years old and under) remain eligible to participate.
2. University students who have previously visited Japan only for a short-term tourist visit of up to 10 days are still eligible.
3. Individuals employed by private enterprises are completely barred from being invited under the program without any exceptions.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explanation_english: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. Under the FY2026 guidelines, high school and technical college students who stayed in Japan only in their childhood (12 years old and under) or visited for up to 10 days as tourists are eligible. For university students, an invitation must be their first time visiting Japan after entering university, but those who visited only for a short-term tourist visit (up to 10 days) remain eligible. Statement 3 is incorrect because while those employed by private companies are generally not eligible in principle, 'those who are in a position deemed vital for promoting public affairs are eligible'.
questions.explanation_hindi: कथन 1 और 2 सही हैं। FY2026 के दिशानिर्देशों के अनुसार, हाई स्कूल और तकनीकी कॉलेज के छात्र जो केवल अपने बचपन (12 वर्ष या उससे कम आयु) में जापान में रहे हों या 10 दिनों तक की पर्यटक यात्रा पर गए हों, वे पात्र हैं। विश्वविद्यालय के छात्रों के लिए, विश्वविद्यालय में प्रवेश के बाद यह उनकी पहली जापान यात्रा होनी चाहिए, लेकिन जो केवल 10 दिनों तक की अल्पकालिक पर्यटक यात्रा पर गए थे, वे भी पात्र हैं। कथन 3 गलत है क्योंकि यद्यपि निजी कंपनियों में कार्यरत व्यक्ति सैद्धांतिक रूप से पात्र नहीं हैं, लेकिन 'जो सार्वजनिक कार्यों को बढ़ावा देने के लिए महत्वपूर्ण माने जाने वाले पद पर हैं, वे पात्र हैं'।
key_facts: Those who have visited Japan only for a short-term tourist visit (up to 10 days) or stayed in Japan only in their childhood (12 years old and under) are still eligible. For university students or others, invitation through this program must be their first time visiting Japan after entering university. Those who have visited Japan only for a short-term tourist visit (up to 10 days) are still eligible. ... In principle, those who are employed by private companies are not eligible for this program. However, those who are in a position deemed vital for promoting public affairs are eligible.

Match List-I (Facility / Team visited at RIKEN Wako Campus) with List-II (Key Research Topic / Specific Activity):

(B) Laser Research Building (Okochi Memorial Hall)
(C) Neutron Engineering Facility
(D) International Affairs Division

List-II

questions.explanation_english: Bio-Polymer Research Team at CSRS hosted a lecture on spider silk research (A-3). At Okochi Memorial Hall, SAITO Takehiko delivered an advanced explanation of the microscopic world of atomic nuclei and origins of matter (B-1). At the Neutron Engineering Facility, KOBAYASHI Tomohiro explained neutron beams and their generation systems (C-4). Kelly Jackson of the International Affairs Division presented an overview of RIKEN's history and facilities (D-2).

key_facts: Group B first visited the Bio-Polymer Research Team at the Center for Sustainable Resource Science, where they attended a lecture by Senior Research Scientist Ari Andres Marai on spider silk research... At 11:00 a.m., the group walked to the Okochi Memorial Hall in the Laser Research Building to attend a lecture by Chief Research Scientist SAITO Takehiko. Following an advanced explanation of the microscopic world of atomic nuclei and the origins of matter in the early universe... The final visit was to the Neutron Engineering Facility, where Research Scientist KOBAYASHI Tomohiro from the Center for Advanced Photonics explained neutron beams... Kelly Jackson, Senior Coordinator from the International Affairs Division, who provided an overview of RIKEN's history, organizational structure, and research facilities across Japan.

questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding the institutional profile of RIKEN as described in the Sakura Science High School Program (SSHP) 2026 Activity Report:

1. RIKEN was founded in 1917 and designated as a National Research and Development Agency in 2015.
2. The Wako campus of RIKEN hosts laboratories covering physics, chemistry, life sciences, and engineering.
3. The visit on May 28 comprised a delegation of 60 participants consisting of 56 high school students and 4 supervisors from India.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explanation_english: All three statements are correct according to the RIKEN 2026 Activity Report. RIKEN was founded in 1917, designated as a National Research and Development Agency in 2015; the Wako campus hosts laboratories across physics, chemistry, life sciences, and engineering; and the Indian delegation comprised 60 participants (56 students and 4 supervisors).
questions.explanation_hindi: रिकेन 2026 गतिविधि रिपोर्ट के अनुसार तीनों कथन सही हैं। रिकेन की स्थापना 1917 में हुई थी और 2015 में इसे राष्ट्रीय अनुसंधान और विकास एजेंसी नामित किया गया था; वाको परिसर भौतिकी, रसायन विज्ञान, जीवन विज्ञान और इंजीनियरिंग प्रयोगशालाओं की मेजबानी करता है; और भारतीय प्रतिनिधिमंडल में 60 प्रतिभागी (56 छात्र और 4 पर्यवेक्षक) शामिल थे।
key_facts: On the morning of May 28, under pleasant early summer weather, 60 participants—56 high school students and 4 supervisors from India—visited RIKEN (The Institute of Physical and Chemical Research) in Wako, Saitama Prefecture, as part of Group 1 of the Sakura Science High School Program (SSHP). Founded in 1917 and designated as a National Research and Development Agency in 2015, RIKEN is one of Japan's leading comprehensive research institutions in the natural sciences. The Wako campus hosts cutting-edge laboratories across a wide range of fields, including physics, chemistry, life sciences, and engineering.

questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding the high school delegation's visit to RIKEN under Group 1 of the Sakura Science High School Program:

Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.explanation_english: Both statements are correct. In Okochi Memorial Hall, Chief Research Scientist SAITO Takehiko delivered a lecture, where a student asked: 'Why can protons, which both carry positive charge, bind together within the atomic nucleus instead of repelling each other?' Following that, at the Neutron Engineering Facility, Research Scientist KOBAYASHI Tomohiro from the Center for Advanced Photonics explained neutron beams and their generation systems.
questions.explanation_hindi: दोनों कथन सही हैं। ओकोची मेमोरियल हॉल में, मुख्य अनुसंधान वैज्ञानिक सैतो ताकेहिको ने एक व्याख्यान दिया, जहाँ एक छात्र ने पूछा: 'Why can protons, which both carry positive charge, bind together within the atomic nucleus instead of repelling each other?' इसके बाद, न्यूट्रॉन इंजीनियरिंग सुविधा में सेंटर फॉर एडवांस्ड फोटोनिक्स के अनुसंधान वैज्ञानिक कोबायाशी तोमोहिरो ने न्यूट्रॉन बीम और उनकी उत्पादन प्रणालियों के बारे में जानकारी दी।
key_facts: One student asked, “Why can protons, which both carry positive charge, bind together within the atomic nucleus instead of repelling each other?” ... The final visit was to the Neutron Engineering Facility, where Research Scientist KOBAYASHI Tomohiro from the Center for Advanced Photonics explained neutron beams, their generation systems, and related research equipment.

questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding the delegation of Indian students participating in the Sakura Science Programme in May 2026:

1. The contingent comprised 24 boys and 32 girls from government schools across 15 States and Union Territories.
2. All participating students in this delegation were beneficiaries of the National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship (NMMS) Scheme.
3. According to the Ministry of Education, 674 Indian students and 96 supervisors have visited Japan under the initiative since India started participating in April 2016.

Furthermore, India has been participating since April 2016, and cumulatively 674 Indian students and 96 supervisors had visited Japan under the initiative by this visit.
questions.explanation_hindi: तीनों कथन सही हैं। मई 2026 के प्रतिनिधिमंडल में 15 राज्यों और केंद्र शासित प्रदेशों के सरकारी स्कूलों के 56 छात्र (24 लड़के और 32 लड़कियां) शामिल थे। सभी छात्र NMMS योजना के लाभार्थी थे। इसके अलावा, भारत अप्रैल 2016 से इस पहल में भाग ले रहा है, और इस यात्रा तक कुल 674 भारतीय छात्र और 96 पर्यवेक्षक जापान का दौरा कर चुके थे।
key_facts: The Indian contingent includes 24 boys and 32 girls from government schools across 15 States and Union Territories... All participating students are beneficiaries of the National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship (NMMS) Scheme of the Government of India. The Japan Science and Technology Agency (JST) has been implementing the Japan Asia Youth Exchange Program in Science, popularly known as the Sakura Science Programme, since 2014 to promote scientific learning and cultural exchange among students. India has been participating in the initiative since April 2016... According to the Ministry, 674 Indian students and 96 supervisors have visited Japan under the initiative so far

1. आवेदन के समय किसी पात्र संगठन में नामांकित उम्मीदवार जो विनिमय कार्यक्रम से पहले स्नातक हो जाते हैं या अपना पद छोड़ देते हैं, वे किसी भी परिस्थिति में भाग नहीं ले सकते।
2. यद्यपि निजी कंपनियों के कर्मचारी सैद्धांतिक रूप से अपात्र हैं, फिर भी सार्वजनिक मामलों को बढ़ावा देने के लिए महत्वपूर्ण माने जाने वाले पदों पर कार्यरत व्यक्तियों के लिए अपवाद की अनुमति है।
3. FY2026 के लिए, उत्तरी अमेरिका, ओशिनिया (चयनित द्वीप देशों और क्षेत्रों को छोड़कर), और यूरोप (यूक्रेन, मध्य एशिया और काकेशस को छोड़कर) कार्यक्रम के लिए अपात्र हैं।

ऊपर दिए गए कथनों में से कौन-से सही हैं?
questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding the participant eligibility norms under the Sakura Science Program FY2026 (Open Application) Guidelines:

1. Candidates enrolled in an eligible organization at the time of application who graduate or leave their position before the exchange program cannot participate under any circumstances.
2. Although employees of private companies are in principle ineligible, an exception is made for individuals holding positions deemed vital for promoting public affairs.
3. For FY2026, North America, Oceania (excluding selected island countries and regions), and Europe (excluding Ukraine, Central Asia, and the Caucasus) are ineligible for the program.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explanation_english: Statement 1 is incorrect because those who graduated or left their position can still participate if they have decided to continue their enrollment by entering a graduate school at the exchange organization. Statements 2 and 3 are correct as per section 1.2 and 1.4 of the FY2026 Application Guidelines.
questions.explanation_hindi: कथन 1 गलत है क्योंकि जो छात्र स्नातक हो चुके हैं या पद छोड़ चुके हैं, वे तब भी भाग ले सकते हैं यदि उन्होंने विनिमय संगठन के ग्रेजुएट स्कूल में प्रवेश लेकर अपना नामांकन जारी रखने का निर्णय लिया हो। FY2026 आवेदन दिशानिर्देशों के खंड 1.2 और 1.4 के अनुसार कथन 2 और 3 सही हैं।
key_facts: Those who were enrolled in an eligible organization at the time of application but graduated or left their position by the time of the exchange program cannot participate, unless they have decided to continue their enrollment by entering a graduate school at the exchange organization. In principle, those who are employed by private companies are not eligible for this program. However, those who are in a position deemed vital for promoting public affairs are eligible... For FY2026, North America, Europe (excluding Ukraine, Central Asia, and the Caucasus), and Oceania (excluding selected island countries and regions) are not eligible for the program.

नीचे दिए गए कूट का उपयोग करके सही उत्तर चुनिए:
questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english:
Match List-I (Parameter/Feature under Sakura Science / INSPIRE MANAK Framework) with List-II (Specific Requirement/Detail): 

List-I:
(A) Eligible school classes for high school nominees from India
(B) Mandatory language requirement for student nominees
(C) Nations participating alongside India in the May 2026 contingent
(D) INSPIRE MANAK initial award amount per student

List-II:
1. Rs. 10,000/- each
2. Classes X, XI & XII
3. Strong proficiency in oral and written English
4. Ghana, Nigeria, and South Africa

Select the correct answer using the code given below:
questions.explanation_english: (A) High school students invited by JST must be studying in classes X, XI & XII. (B) The selection norm specifies that the student should have a strong proficiency in oral and written English. (C) Alongside the Indian delegation in May 2026, students from Ghana, Nigeria, and South Africa participated. (D) Under the INSPIRE MANAK scheme, selected students receive Rs. 10,000/- each for preparing a Science Project / Model.
questions.explanation_hindi: (A) JST द्वारा आमंत्रित हाई स्कूल के छात्रों को कक्षा X, XI और XII में अध्ययनरत होना चाहिए। (B) चयन मानदंड निर्दिष्ट करता है कि छात्र के पास मौखिक और लिखित अंग्रेजी में मजबूत दक्षता होनी चाहिए। (C) मई 2026 में भारतीय प्रतिनिधिमंडल के साथ घाना, नाइजीरिया और दक्षिण अफ्रीका के प्रतिभागियों ने भाग लिया। (D) इंस्पायर मानक योजना के तहत, चयनित छात्रों को विज्ञान परियोजना / मॉडल तैयार करने के लिए रु. 10,000/- प्रत्येक प्रदान किए जाते हैं।
key_facts: Under this scheme, students are selected from the middle and high school of the country for an INSPIRE MANAK Rs.10000/- each for preparing a Science Project / Model... Through this program the JST invites students presently studying in classes X, XI & XII and are above 15 years of age from India to visit Japan... The student should have a strong proficiency in oral and written English to understand and express thoughts without any difficulty... alongside participants from Ghana, Nigeria and South Africa.

questions.question_hindi:
सकुरा साइंस एक्सचेंज प्रोग्राम ढांचे के तहत प्रशासित "लोटस (LOTUS) कार्यक्रम" के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:

1. यह भारत से स्नातक छात्रों (ग्रेजुएट स्टूडेंट्स) और पोस्टडॉक्टोरल शोधकर्ताओं को आमंत्रित करके अंतर्राष्ट्रीय प्रतिभा संचलन को बढ़ावा देने के लिए तैयार किया गया है।
2. इस पहल के तहत परिचालन ट्रैक्स में "LOTUS-ASPIRE" और "LOTUS Basic" शामिल हैं।

उपर्युक्त कथनों में से कौन-सा/से सही है/हैं?
questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding the "LOTUS Programme" administered under the Sakura Science Exchange Program framework:

1. It is designed to promote international talent circulation by inviting graduate students and postdoctoral researchers from India.
2. The operational tracks under this initiative include "LOTUS-ASPIRE" and "LOTUS Basic".

Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.explanation_english: According to the official Sakura Science Exchange Program portal, the LOTUS Programme is dedicated to 'Promoting International Talent Circulation by Inviting Graduate Students and Postdoctoral Researchers from India' and comprises two tracks: 'LOTUS-ASPIRE' + 'LOTUS Basic'. Thus, both statements 1 and 2 are correct.
questions.explanation_hindi: आधिकारिक सकुरा साइंस एक्सचेंज प्रोग्राम पोर्टल के अनुसार, लोटस कार्यक्रम 'भारत से स्नातक छात्रों और पोस्टडॉक्टोरल शोधकर्ताओं को आमंत्रित करके अंतर्राष्ट्रीय प्रतिभा संचलन को बढ़ावा देने' के लिए समर्पित है और इसमें दो ट्रैक शामिल हैं: 'LOTUS-ASPIRE' + 'LOTUS Basic'। अतः कथन 1 और 2 दोनों सही हैं।
key_facts: LOTUS Programme Promoting International Talent Circulation by Inviting Graduate Students and Postdoctoral Researchers from India “LOTUS-ASPIRE” + “LOTUS Basic”

questions.question_hindi: सकुरा साइंस एक्सचेंज प्रोग्राम (वित्त वर्ष 2026 गतिविधि रिपोर्ट और मेजबान व्यवस्था) के संबंध में निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा युग्म सही सुमेलित नहीं है?
options_hindi: होक्काइडो विश्वविद्यालय (कोर्स A) : कृषि और स्वास्थ्य विज्ञान अनुसंधान में संधारणीय प्रौद्योगिकियों का अनुभव
क्योटो विश्वविद्यालय कोर्स (SSHP) : सुइता परिसर और मिनोह परिसर
केइओ विश्वविद्यालय (कोर्स B) : अनदेखे अणुओं के निर्माण और वैश्विक लीडर्स विकसित करने के लिए रासायनिक अनुसंधान
केइओ विश्वविद्यालय कोर्स B भागीदार : नेशनल त्सिंग हुआ विश्वविद्यालय (सिंचु सिटी, ताइवान)
questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english: Which of the following pairs regarding the Sakura Science Exchange Program (FY2026 activity reports and host arrangements) is NOT correctly matched?
options_english: Hokkaido University (Course A) : Experiencing sustainable technologies in agriculture and health science research
Kyoto University Course (SSHP) : Suita Campus and Minoh Campus
Keio University (Course B) : Chemical Research for Creating Unexplored Molecules and Developing Global Leaders
Keio University Course B Partner : National Tsing Hua University (Hsinchu City, Taiwan)
questions.explanation_english: Pair (d) is NOT correctly matched. The activity reports of the Sakura Science High School Program's Kyoto University Course were published specifically for Kyoto University's Yoshida Campus and Kyoto University's Katsura Campus (not Suita or Minoh Campus). All other pairs are correctly matched.
questions.explanation_hindi: युग्म (d) सही सुमेलित नहीं है। सकुरा साइंस हाई स्कूल प्रोग्राम के क्योटो विश्वविद्यालय कोर्स की गतिविधि रिपोर्ट विशेष रूप से क्योटो विश्वविद्यालय के योशिदा परिसर और क्योटो विश्वविद्यालय के कात्सुरा परिसर के लिए प्रकाशित की गई थीं (सुइता या मिनोह परिसर नहीं)। अन्य सभी युग्म सही सुमेलित हैं।
key_facts: Activity Reports of SAKURA SCIENCE High School Program's Kyoto University Course have been published. (Kyoto University’s Yoshida Campus, Kyoto University’s Katsura Campus)

questions.question_hindi:

1. यह कार्यक्रम 6 सितंबर से 12 सितंबर 2026 तक निर्धारित और आयोजित किया गया था।
2. तीन भारतीय संस्थानों के दो संकाय सदस्यों और छह छात्रों सहित कुल आठ प्रतिभागियों के एक दल ने इस कार्यक्रम में भाग लिया।
3. यह पहल "अनदेखे अणुओं के निर्माण और वैश्विक लीडर्स विकसित करने के लिए रासायनिक अनुसंधान" विषय के तहत आयोजित की गई थी।

उपर्युक्त कथनों में से कौन-से सही हैं?
questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding the Sakura Science Program (Course A) exchange conducted at Hokkaido University in September 2026:

1. The program was scheduled and conducted from September 6 to September 12, 2026.
2. A contingent of eight participants, consisting of two faculty members and six students from three Indian institutions, took part in the program.
3. The initiative was conducted under the theme "Chemical Research for Creating Unexplored Molecules and Developing Global Leaders".

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explanation_english: Statements 1 and 2 are correct as the program took place from September 6 to September 12, 2026, with 8 participants (2 faculty members and 6 students from three Indian institutions). Statement 3 is incorrect because Hokkaido University's theme was 'Experiencing sustainable technologies in agriculture and health science research'; the theme 'Chemical Research for Creating Unexplored Molecules and Developing Global Leaders' belonged to Keio University's Course B.
questions.explanation_hindi: कथन 1 और 2 सही हैं क्योंकि यह कार्यक्रम 6 सितंबर से 12 सितंबर 2026 तक 8 प्रतिभागियों (तीन भारतीय संस्थानों के 2 संकाय सदस्य और 6 छात्र) के साथ आयोजित किया गया था। कथन 3 गलत है क्योंकि होक्काइडो विश्वविद्यालय का विषय 'कृषि और स्वास्थ्य विज्ञान अनुसंधान में संधारणीय प्रौद्योगिकियों का अनुभव' था; जबकि 'अनदेखे अणुओं के निर्माण और वैश्विक लीडर्स विकसित करने के लिए रासायनिक अनुसंधान' विषय केइओ विश्वविद्यालय के कोर्स B का था।
key_facts: The Sakura Science Program (SSP) was conducted at Hokkaido University from September 6 to September 12, 2026. A total of eight participants, including two faculty members and six students from three Indian institutions participated in the program.

उपर्युक्त कथनों में से कौन-से सही हैं?
questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding host organizations, supervisors, and invitees under the Sakura Science Program (Open Application) FY2026 Guidelines:

1. Where private enterprises serve as the Japanese host organization, JST funding covers only airfare.
2. It is preferable that the designated supervisor be 40 years old or under and visiting Japan for the first time through this program.
3. For university students, participation is permitted provided it is their first time visiting Japan after entering university, with prior short-term tourist visits up to 10 days being permissible.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explanation_english:
All three statements are correct under the FY2026 Application Guidelines:

questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding the selection of Indian students for the SAKURA Science High School Program (SSHP) batch scheduled for June–July 2026:

1. A batch of 56 students was invited by the Japan Science and Technology Agency (JST) for the program scheduled from 28 June 2026 to 4 July 2026.
2. The nominees were selected from the winners of the 8th, 9th, and 10th NLEPC, as well as students qualifying the Level-I evaluation of the 11th NLEPC.
3. Since the Department of Science and Technology (DST) began participating in 2015, a total of 396 students and 56 supervisors had successfully completed the exchange program prior to this batch.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explanation_english: All three statements are correct as per the official DST INSPIRE letter. JST invited 56 students for the batch scheduled from 28 June 2026 to 4 July 2026. These students were selected from the winners of the 8th, 9th, and 10th NLEPC and those who qualified Level-I evaluation of the 11th NLEPC. Furthermore, DST has participated in the initiative since 2015, with 396 students and 56 supervisors having successfully completed the exchange program.
questions.explanation_hindi: आधिकारिक DST INSPIRE पत्र के अनुसार तीनों कथन सही हैं। JST ने 28 जून 2026 से 4 जुलाई 2026 तक निर्धारित बैच के लिए 56 छात्रों को आमंत्रित किया। इन छात्रों का चयन 8वीं, 9वीं और 10वीं NLEPC के विजेताओं और 11वीं NLEPC के लेवल-I मूल्यांकन में उत्तीर्ण छात्रों में से किया गया था। इसके अलावा, DST 2015 से इस पहल में भाग ले रहा है, जिसके तहत 396 छात्रों और 56 पर्यवेक्षकों ने सफलतापूर्वक विनिमय कार्यक्रम पूरा किया था।
key_facts: The JST has now invited 56 students in one batch during 28 June 2026- 4 July 2026. Accordingly, DST would be selecting 56 INSPIRE MANAK winners for the SAKURA Science High School Program of Japan. These students would be selected from the winners of 8 th NLEPC/ 9 th NLEPC/10 th NLEPC/ and from students who qualified Level-I evaluation of 11 th NLEPC, who were satisfying the eligibility criteria laid down by JST... Till now a total of 396 students and 56 supervisors have successfully completed the exchange program.

2. विनिमय के पात्र क्षेत्रों में प्राकृतिक विज्ञान और मानविकी/सामाजिक विज्ञान दोनों शामिल हैं।
3. हाई स्कूल या तकनीकी कॉलेज के छात्र जो केवल अपने बचपन (12 वर्ष और उससे कम उम्र) में जापान में रहे हैं, वे भी पहली बार आने वाले आगंतुक के रूप में पात्र हैं।

questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding the basic framework and invitee norms of the Sakura Science Program established by the Japan Science and Technology Agency (JST):

1. The Sakura Science Program was established by JST in the year 2014.
2. The eligible fields of exchange encompass both natural sciences and humanities/social sciences.
3. High school or technical college students who have stayed in Japan only in their childhood (12 years old and under) are still eligible as first-time visitors.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explanation_english: All three statements are correct under the FY2026 Application Guidelines. The Sakura Science Program was established by JST in 2014. The fields of exchange officially include natural sciences as well as humanities/social sciences. High school and technical college students who have only stayed in Japan during childhood (12 years old and under) or visited for short-term tourism (up to 10 days) remain eligible under the first-time visitor rule.
questions.explanation_hindi: FY2026 आवेदन दिशानिर्देशों के तहत तीनों कथन सही हैं। सकुरा साइंस प्रोग्राम की स्थापना JST द्वारा 2014 में की गई थी। विनिमय के क्षेत्रों में आधिकारिक तौर पर प्राकृतिक विज्ञान के साथ-साथ मानविकी/सामाजिक विज्ञान भी शामिल हैं। हाई स्कूल और तकनीकी कॉलेज के छात्र जो केवल बचपन में (12 वर्ष या उससे कम उम्र) जापान में रहे हैं या अल्पकालिक पर्यटन (10 दिनों तक) के लिए गए हैं, वे पहली बार आने वाले नियम के तहत पात्र रहते हैं।
key_facts: In 2014, the Japan Science and Technology Agency (JST) established the “Sakura Science Program.” ... 1.3 Fields of exchange Science and technology (natural sciences, humanities/ social sciences) ... Those who have visited Japan only for a short-term tourist visit (up to 10 days) or stayed in Japan only in their childhood (12 years old and under) are still eligible.

questions.question_hindi:
इन्स्पायर मानक (INSPIRE MANAK) प्रतियोगिता संरचना के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए, जिससे भारतीय छात्रों को सकुरा साइंस हाई स्कूल प्रोग्राम के लिए चुना जाता है:

1. विज्ञान परियोजना/मॉडल तैयार करने के लिए चयनित प्रारंभिक पुरस्कार विजेता सभी 28 राज्यों और 8 केंद्र शासित प्रदेशों के कक्षा 6 से 10वीं के छात्र होते हैं।
2. यह प्रतियोगिता त्रि-स्तरीय मूल्यांकन प्रणाली: जिला, राज्य और राष्ट्रीय स्तर पर आयोजित की जाती है।

ऊपर दिए गए कथनों में से कौन-सा/से सही है/हैं?
questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding the INSPIRE MANAK competition structure from which Indian students are selected for the Sakura Science High School Program:

1. The initial awardees selected for preparing a Science Project / Model are students from classes 6th to 10th across all 28 States and 8 Union Territories.
2. The competition is conducted across a three-tier evaluation system: District, State, and National Level.

Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.explanation_english: Both statements are correct. Under the INSPIRE MANAK scheme, middle and high school students from classes 6th to 10th from all 28 states and 8 UTs are awarded for preparing a science model/project, and they subsequently participate in a three-tier competition: District, State, and National Level (NLEPC).
questions.explanation_hindi: दोनों कथन सही हैं। इन्स्पायर मानक (INSPIRE MANAK) योजना के तहत, सभी 28 राज्यों और 8 केंद्र शासित प्रदेशों के कक्षा 6 से 10वीं के मिडिल और हाई स्कूल के छात्रों को एक विज्ञान मॉडल/परियोजना तैयार करने के लिए पुरस्कृत किया जाता है, और वे बाद में तीन स्तरीय प्रतियोगिता: जिला, राज्य और राष्ट्रीय स्तर (NLEPC) में भाग लेते हैं।
key_facts: These awardees, who are students from classes 6 th to 10 th, then participate in a three tier competition: District, State and National Level. The projects exhibited are evaluated by a jury of experts. All the 28 states and 8 UTs are participating in the scheme.

2. जापान में स्वतंत्र प्रशासनिक एजेंसियां (Independent administrative agencies) और स्थानीय सार्वजनिक निकाय जापानी मेजबान संगठन के रूप में कार्य करने के लिए पात्र हैं।

questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding the operational norms under the Sakura Science Program (Open Application) FY2026 Guidelines:

1. Applications under the program must be prepared and submitted directly by overseas sending institutions to JST.
2. Independent administrative agencies and local public entities in Japan are eligible to serve as Japanese host organizations.

1. छात्र को शैक्षणिक सत्र 2026-27 के दौरान कक्षा X, XI या XII में अध्ययनरत होना चाहिए।

questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding the selection norms for Indian students nominated for the SAKURA Science High School Program (SSHP) under the INSPIRE MANAK framework:

1. The student must be studying in class X, XI or XII during the 2026-27 academic session.
2. The student must be 15 years old or older at the time of arrival in Japan.
3. Students who have participated in the International Science Olympiads or have won prizes in domestic science events/contests are preferable.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explanation_english: All three statements are correct under the official selection norms: 1.1 states the student should be studying in class X, XI or XII during the academic year in which the programme takes place (i.e., 2026-27 academic session) and be 15 years old or older on arrival in Japan; 1.4 mentions that students who have participated in International Science Olympiads or won prizes in domestic science contests are preferable.
questions.explanation_hindi: आधिकारिक चयन मानदंडों के तहत तीनों कथन सही हैं: बिंदु 1.1 के अनुसार छात्र को कार्यक्रम वाले शैक्षणिक सत्र (2026-27 सत्र) के दौरान कक्षा X, XI या XII में पढ़ना चाहिए और जापान आगमन पर 15 वर्ष या उससे अधिक आयु का होना चाहिए; बिंदु 1.4 में उल्लेख है कि जिन्होंने अंतर्राष्ट्रीय विज्ञान ओलंपियाड में भाग लिया है या घरेलू प्रतियोगिताओं में पुरस्कार जीता है, उन्हें वरीयता दी जाती है।

questions.question_hindi:
जापान विज्ञान एवं प्रौद्योगिकी एजेंसी (JST) द्वारा आधिकारिक रूप से निर्दिष्ट सकुरा साइंस प्रोग्राम के मुख्य उद्देश्यों के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:

1. विज्ञान और प्रौद्योगिकी में नवाचार में योगदान करने की क्षमता रखने वाले विदेशी प्रतिभाशाली मानव संसाधनों के विकास का समर्थन करना इसका एक स्पष्ट उद्देश्य है।
2. यह कार्यक्रम अंतर्राष्ट्रीय प्रतिभा संचलन (talent circulation) में तेजी लाने और जापानी तथा विदेशी शैक्षिक/अनुसंधान संस्थानों के बीच निरंतर सहयोग और संपर्क को बढ़ावा देना चाहता है।
3. विज्ञान और प्रौद्योगिकी कूटनीति (diplomacy) में सहायता करने के लिए जापान और अन्य देशों/क्षेत्रों के बीच अच्छे संबंधों को मजबूत करना इसके प्रमुख उद्देश्यों में शामिल है।

ऊपर दिए गए कथनों में से कौन-से सही हैं?
questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding the core objectives of the Sakura Science Program as officially specified by the Japan Science and Technology Agency (JST):

1. Supporting the development of overseas talented human resources who have the potential to contribute to innovation in science and technology is an explicit objective.
2. The program seeks to accelerate international talent circulation and promote continuous collaboration, cooperation, and interaction between Japanese and overseas educational/research institutes.
3. Strengthening good relationships between Japan and other countries and regions to aid science and technology diplomacy is designated as one of its core purposes.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explanation_english: All three statements are correct. Section 1.1 of the FY2026 guidelines lists the program's objectives verbatim as: (i) To support the development of talented human resources from overseas who have the potential to contribute to innovation in science and technology, (ii) To Accelerate the international talent circulation, (iii) To promote continuous collaboration, cooperation and interaction between Japanese educational and research institutes and overseas ones, and (iv) To strengthen good relationship between Japan and other countries and regions that will help science and technology diplomacy.
questions.explanation_hindi: तीनों कथन सही हैं। वित्त वर्ष 2026 के दिशानिर्देशों की धारा 1.1 कार्यक्रम के उद्देश्यों को इस प्रकार सूचीबद्ध करती है: (i) विदेशी प्रतिभाशाली मानव संसाधनों के विकास का समर्थन करना जिनमें नवाचार में योगदान करने की क्षमता हो, (ii) अंतर्राष्ट्रीय प्रतिभा संचलन में तेजी लाना, (iii) जापानी और विदेशी संस्थानों के बीच निरंतर सहयोग को बढ़ावा देना, और (iv) विज्ञान और प्रौद्योगिकी कूटनीति में सहायता करने वाले अच्छे संबंधों को मजबूत करना।
key_facts: The Sakura Science Program’s objectives include: To support the development of talented human resources from overseas who have the potential to contribute to innovation in science and technology. To Accelerate the international talent circulation. To promote continuous collaboration, cooperation and interaction between Japanese educational and research institutes and overseas ones. To strengthen good relationship between Japan and other countries and regions that will help science and technology diplomacy.

4. पर्यवेक्षकों के लिए अनिवार्य है कि उनकी आयु 35 वर्ष से कम होनी चाहिए।

questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding the invitee and supervisor requirements under the Sakura Science Program (Open Application) FY2026 Guidelines:

1. In principle, individuals employed by private enterprises are completely barred from participating, without any exceptions.
2. Main invitees who were enrolled in an eligible organization at the time of application but graduated or left their position prior to the exchange cannot participate, unless they continue their enrollment by entering a graduate school at the exchange organization.
3. University students who previously visited Japan for a short-term tourist visit of up to 10 days are not disqualified from being eligible as first-time visitors after entering university.
4. For supervisors, it is mandatory that they be strictly under 35 years of age.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explanation_english: Statement 1 is incorrect because those employed by private enterprises are eligible if they are in a position deemed vital for promoting public affairs. Statement 2 is correct as explicitly stated under Affiliation/Age rules. Statement 3 is correct because those who have visited Japan only for a short-term tourist visit (up to 10 days) are still eligible. Statement 4 is incorrect because it is 'preferable' (not mandatory) that the supervisor be 40 years old or under (not 35).
questions.explanation_hindi: कथन 1 गलत है क्योंकि निजी कंपनियों में कार्यरत व्यक्ति पात्र हैं यदि वे सार्वजनिक मामलों को बढ़ावा देने के लिए महत्वपूर्ण माने जाने वाले पद पर हैं। कथन 2 सही है क्योंकि संबद्धता/आयु नियमों के तहत यह स्पष्ट रूप से उल्लेखित है। कथन 3 सही है क्योंकि जिन लोगों ने केवल अल्पकालिक पर्यटक यात्रा (10 दिनों तक) के लिए जापान का दौरा किया है, वे अभी भी पात्र हैं। कथन 4 गलत है क्योंकि पर्यवेक्षक के लिए 40 वर्ष या उससे कम (35 नहीं) होना 'प्राथमिकता' (preferable) है, अनिवार्य नहीं।
key_facts: * Those who were enrolled in an eligible organization at the time of application but graduated or left their position by the time of the exchange program cannot participate, unless they have decided to continue their enrollment by entering a graduate school at the exchange organization. * In principle, those who are employed by private companies are not eligible for this program. However, those who are in a position deemed vital for promoting public affairs are eligible. ... For university students or others, invitation through this program must be their first time visiting Japan after entering university. Those who have visited Japan only for a short-term tourist visit (up to 10 days) are still eligible. ... It is preferable that the supervisor be 40 years old or under

key_facts: Universities, technical colleges, high schools, national research and development agencies, independent administrative agencies, private enterprises, local public entities, organizations having corporate status such as public corporation or general corporation in Japan are eligible. *In the case of private enterprises, only airfare will be covered by JST.

1. चयनित विद्यार्थियों और नामित पर्यवेक्षकों के लिए भारत के भीतर स्थानीय व्यय से संबंधित खर्च DST द्वारा वहन किया जाता है।
2. JST द्वारा विदेशी राउंड-ट्रिप हवाई किराया और हवाई अड्डा कर वहन किया जाता है।

उपर्युक्त कथनों में से कौन-से सही हैं?
questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding the financial cost-sharing between the Department of Science and Technology (DST) and the Japan Science and Technology Agency (JST) for the SAKURA Science High School Program:

1. DST bears the expenditures related to local expenditure within India for the selected students and designated supervisors.
2. JST covers overseas round-trip airfare and airport taxes.
3. Programme implementation fees, including accommodation, meal expenses, traveling costs within Japan, and travel insurance, are borne by JST.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explanation_english: According to the official DST guidelines, DST bears the expenditures related to local expenditure within India, etc. for selected students and designated supervisors. JST covers overseas airfare (round trip airfare, airport taxes, etc.) and Programme Implementation Fees (accommodation fees, meal expenses, travelling costs in Japan for students and supervisors, and travel insurance).
questions.explanation_hindi: आधिकारिक DST दिशानिर्देशों के अनुसार, चयनित विद्यार्थियों और नामित पर्यवेक्षकों के लिए भारत के भीतर स्थानीय व्यय आदि DST वहन करता है। JST द्वारा विदेशी हवाई किराया (राउंड ट्रिप हवाई किराया, हवाई अड्डा कर आदि) और कार्यक्रम कार्यान्वयन शुल्क (आवास शुल्क, भोजन व्यय, जापान में छात्रों व पर्यवेक्षकों की यात्रा लागत, तथा यात्रा बीमा) वहन किया जाता है।
key_facts: DST would be bearing the expenditures related to local expenditure within India, etc. for the selected students and designated supervisors for going to Japan, while JST would cover the following costs: Overseas Airfare: round trip airfare, and airport taxes etc. Programme Implementation Fees: - Accommodation fees, meal expenses, travelling costs in Japan (for students and supervisor) - Travel Insurance

questions.question_hindi:
DST इंस्पायर मानक (INSPIRE MANAK) ढांचे के तहत 28 जून 2026 से 4 जुलाई 2026 तक जापान का दौरा करने वाले सकुरा साइंस हाई स्कूल प्रोग्राम बैच के नामांकन और विवरण के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:

1. JST ने 28 जून 2026 से 4 जुलाई 2026 की अवधि के लिए एक बैच में 56 छात्रों के दल को आमंत्रित किया।
2. छात्रों का चयन 8वें, 9वें और 10वें NLEPC के विजेताओं और 11वें NLEPC के लेवल-I मूल्यांकन में अर्हता प्राप्त छात्रों में से किया जाता है।
3. DST द्वारा 2015 से इस विनिमय कार्यक्रम में भाग लेने के बाद से, इस बैच से पूर्व कुल 396 छात्रों और 56 पर्यवेक्षकों ने कार्यक्रम पूरा किया था।

उपर्युक्त कथनों में से कौन-से सही हैं?
questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding the nomination and batch details for the SAKURA Science High School Program batch visiting Japan from 28 June 2026 to 4 July 2026 under the DST INSPIRE MANAK framework:

1. JST invited a contingent of 56 students in one batch for the duration of 28 June 2026 to 4 July 2026.
2. The students are selected from the winners of the 8th, 9th, and 10th NLEPC, and from students who qualified Level-I evaluation of the 11th NLEPC.
3. Since DST started participating in the exchange program in 2015, a total of 396 students and 56 supervisors had completed the program prior to this batch.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explanation_english: All three statements are factually correct. The DST guidelines state: 'The Department has been successfully participating in the exchange program since 2015. Till now a total of 396 students and 56 supervisors have successfully completed the exchange program.' Furthermore, 'The JST has now invited 56 students in one batch during 28 June 2026- 4 July 2026... These students would be selected from the winners of 8th NLEPC/ 9th NLEPC/10th NLEPC/ and from students who qualified Level-I evaluation of 11th NLEPC'.
questions.explanation_hindi: तीनों कथन तथ्यात्मक रूप से सही हैं। DST दिशानिर्देशों के अनुसार: विभाग 2015 से इस विनिमय कार्यक्रम में सफलतापूर्वक भाग ले रहा है और अब तक कुल 396 छात्रों और 56 पर्यवेक्षकों ने इस कार्यक्रम को पूरा किया है। इसके अलावा, JST ने 28 जून 2026 से 4 जुलाई 2026 के दौरान 56 छात्रों को आमंत्रित किया, जिनका चयन 8वें/9वें/10वें NLEPC के विजेताओं तथा 11वें NLEPC के लेवल-I उत्तीर्ण छात्रों में से किया जाना था।
key_facts: The Department has been successfully participating in the exchange program since 2015. Till now a total of 396 students and 56 supervisors have successfully completed the exchange program. The JST has now invited 56 students in one batch during 28 June 2026- 4 July 2026. Accordingly, DST would be selecting 56 INSPIRE MANAK winners for the SAKURA Science High School Program of Japan. These students would be selected from the winners of 8 th NLEPC/ 9 th NLEPC/10 th NLEPC/ and from students who qualified Level-I evaluation of 11 th NLEPC

questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding the basic framework and objectives of the Sakura Science Program (Open Application) FY2026:

1. One of the designated objectives is to accelerate international talent circulation.

3. The eligible fields of exchange are strictly confined to natural sciences, explicitly excluding humanities and social sciences.

Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.explanation_english: Statements 1 and 2 are explicit objectives of the Sakura Science Program. Statement 3 is incorrect because Section 1.3 explicitly defines the fields of exchange as 'Science and technology (natural sciences, humanities/ social sciences)'.
questions.explanation_hindi: कथन 1 और 2 सकुरा साइंस प्रोग्राम के स्पष्ट उद्देश्य हैं। कथन 3 गलत है क्योंकि धारा 1.3 में आदान-प्रदान के क्षेत्रों को स्पष्ट रूप से 'विज्ञान और प्रौद्योगिकी (प्राकृतिक विज्ञान, मानविकी/सामाजिक विज्ञान)' के रूप में परिभाषित किया गया है।
key_facts: The Sakura Science Program’s objectives include: To support the development of talented human resources from overseas who have the potential to contribute to innovation in science and technology. To Accelerate the international talent circulation. To promote continuous collaboration, cooperation and interaction between Japanese educational and research institutes and overseas ones. To strengthen good relationship between Japan and other countries and regions that will help science and technology diplomacy. 1.3 Fields of exchange Science and technology (natural sciences, humanities/ social sciences)

questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding the implementation design of Course D (Annual Mutual Exchange Course) under the Sakura Science Program FY2026:

1. The goal of Course D is to strengthen relations between people and institutions in Japan and India/Africa by fostering sustainable exchange activities and promoting international talent circulation.
2. Participating institutions in Japan and India/Africa are expected to select a shared social issue as a theme and implement a project-based exchange throughout the year.
3. These collaborations are realized by utilizing existing networks cultivated through past Sakura Science Program (Course A/B/C) exchange activities.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explanation_english: All three statements are correct. Course D aims to strengthen relations between Japan and India/Africa, relies on selecting a shared social issue as a theme for year-round project-based exchanges, and leverages existing relationships developed during earlier Course A/B/C activities.
questions.explanation_hindi: तीनों कथन सही हैं। कोर्स D का उद्देश्य जापान और भारत/अफ्रीका के बीच संबंधों को मजबूत करना है, यह पूरे वर्ष परियोजना-आधारित आदान-प्रदान के लिए एक साझा सामाजिक मुद्दे को चुनने पर निर्भर करता है, और पूर्ववर्ती कोर्स A/B/C गतिविधियों के दौरान विकसित मौजूदा संबंधों का लाभ उठाता है।
key_facts: The goal is to strengthen the relations between people and institutions in Japan and India/Africa by fostering exchange activities that are sustainable and promotes international talent circulation. For example, Japan and India/Africa will select a shared social issue as a theme and implement a project based exchange (*) (dispatch/invitation) through inter-institutional collaborations (**) throughout the year. These collaborations will be realized by utilizing the existing networks and relations between Japanese organizations and counterpart country organizations cultivated by the past Sakura Science Program (Course A/B/C) exchange activities, etc.

questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding the eligibility criteria and basic framework under the Sakura Science Program (Open Application) FY2026 Guidelines:

1. Under eligible countries/regions for FY2026, European countries are completely excluded without any regional exceptions.
2. In principle, individuals employed by private enterprises are not eligible, but an exception is made for those deemed vital for promoting public affairs.
3. For accompanying supervisors, it is preferable that they be 40 years old or under and visiting Japan for the first time through this program.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explanation_english: Statement 1 is incorrect because Europe is excluded 'excluding Ukraine, Central Asia, and the Caucasus' (meaning Ukraine, Central Asia, and the Caucasus are eligible exceptions). Statement 2 is correct as individuals employed by private companies deemed vital for promoting public affairs are eligible. Statement 3 is correct as the guidelines state: 'It is preferable that the supervisor be 40 years old or under and visiting Japan for the first time through this program.'
questions.explanation_hindi: कथन 1 गलत है क्योंकि वित्तीय वर्ष 2026 के लिए यूरोप अपात्र है लेकिन 'यूक्रेन, मध्य एशिया और काकेशस को छोड़कर' (अर्थात यूक्रेन, मध्य एशिया और काकेशस पात्र अपवाद हैं)। कथन 2 सही है क्योंकि निजी कंपनियों में नियोजित वे व्यक्ति पात्र हैं जो सार्वजनिक कार्यों को बढ़ावा देने के लिए आवश्यक पद पर हैं। कथन 3 सही है क्योंकि दिशानिर्देशों के अनुसार पर्यवेक्षक के लिए 40 वर्ष या उससे कम आयु का होना और पहली बार जापान आना वांछनीय है।

In principle, those who are employed by private companies are not eligible for this program. However, those who are in a position deemed vital for promoting public affairs are eligible... उपर्युक्त कथनों में से कौन-से सही हैं?
questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding the eligibility requirements for invitees and host organizations under the Sakura Science Program (Open Application) FY2026 Guidelines:

1. High school and technical college students who previously stayed in Japan are eligible only if that stay was during their childhood (12 years old and under) or for short-term tourism up to 10 days.
2. For university students, an invitation through the program must be their first time visiting Japan after entering university, though prior short-term tourist visits up to 10 days are permitted.
3. In the case of private enterprises in Japan acting as the host organization, JST covers only the airfare expenses.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explanation_english: All three statements are correct. According to section 1.4(2) of the FY2026 guidelines, high school/technical college students must be first-time visitors unless prior visits were tourist stays up to 10 days or during childhood (12 years old and under). University students must not have visited Japan after enrolling in university (except short-term tourist trips up to 10 days). Under section 1.6, if private enterprises act as host organizations, JST covers only airfare.
questions.explanation_hindi: तीनों कथन सही हैं। FY2026 दिशानिर्देशों की धारा 1.4(2) के अनुसार, हाई स्कूल/तकनीकी कॉलेज के छात्रों के लिए यह पहली यात्रा होनी चाहिए, जब तक कि पूर्व प्रवास 10 दिनों तक का पर्यटन न रहा हो या बचपन (12 वर्ष या उससे कम) का न हो। विश्वविद्यालय के छात्रों के लिए विश्वविद्यालय में प्रवेश के बाद यह पहली यात्रा होनी चाहिए (10 दिनों तक की पर्यटक यात्रा को छोड़कर)। धारा 1.6 के तहत निजी उद्यमों के मेजबान होने पर केवल हवाई किराया ही JST वहन करता है।
key_facts: Those who have visited Japan only for a short-term tourist visit (up to 10 days) or stayed in Japan only in their childhood (12 years old and under) are still eligible. For university students or others, invitation through this program must be their first time visiting Japan after entering university. Those who have visited Japan only for a short-term tourist visit (up to 10 days) are still eligible.

questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english: In which year was the 'Sakura Science Program' originally established by the Japan Science and Technology Agency (JST)?
questions.explanation_english: In 2014, the Japan Science and Technology Agency (JST) established the 'Sakura Science Program' to invite talented young individuals to Japan to experience cutting-edge science, technology, and culture.
questions.explanation_hindi: वर्ष 2014 में, जापान साइंस एंड टेक्नोलॉजी एजेंसी (JST) ने मेधावी युवा व्यक्तियों को जापान की अत्याधुनिक विज्ञान, प्रौद्योगिकी और संस्कृति का अनुभव कराने के लिए 'सकुरा साइंस प्रोग्राम' की स्थापना की थी।
key_facts: In 2014, the Japan Science and Technology Agency (JST) established the “Sakura Science Program.”
